known.convention: compute-engine clamps a count past the length to the whole source (or nothing), by design, since a lazy source has no length to check (cortex-js/compute-engine#414); Wolfram leaves the call unevaluated.
source: Wolfram: Drop[{1,2},-5] raises Drop::drop (only 2 elements, 5 requested) and leaves the expression unevaluated -- not a clamp.
caption: A negative count past the source's length clamps to dropping everything
wolfram.note: Wolfram raises a message and leaves the call unevaluated; compute-engine clamps the count (cortex-js/compute-engine#414), and ours follows.
